sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English podcast.
I am happy you are here.
Today, we will talk about Luxembourg.
Luxembourg is a small but important country
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
It is next to Belgium, France, and Germany.
Luxembourg is very rich and peaceful.
What is the capital city of Luxembourg?
The capital city is also called Luxembourg,
It is sometimes called Luxembourg City.
It is a mix of history and modern life.
It is also home to many European Union offices.
How many people live in Luxembourg?
It is a very small country,
but people from many countries live there.
More than half the people are from other countries.
Many people work in banks, technology,
What language do people speak in Luxembourg?
Luxembourgish spoken at home and in daily life.
French used in government, law, and signs.
German used in newspapers and schools.
People often speak four or five languages.
What is the weather like in Luxembourg?
Autumn with colorful leaves and rain.
It rains often, but not too much.
The weather is good for walking and cycling.
It is a very clean and natural country.
The Moselle River is a famous place
In the countryside you can see
foxes, deer rabbits, birds, wild boars.
There are also cows and sheep on farms.
Nature is protected and there are many parks.
What do people eat in Luxembourg?
Luxembourgish food is a mix of German,
Sausages and stews fish from the river,
For dessert, they eat apple cake,
What do people drink in Luxembourg?
People drink water, coffee, tea, and juice.
There are also small breweries that make beer.
What is life like in Luxembourg?
Life in Luxembourg is calm, clean,
People go to school and work,
then enjoy free time in the evening.
It has a good healthcare system
